paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 7, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1, with units of AL. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale with values ranging from 12 to 28, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 2. The plot features four lines: Consistency-CE, represented by a purple dashed line with circular markers; Inconsistency-CE, represented by a dark purple dashed line with square markers; Inconsistency-CE-MP, represented by a blue dashed line with square markers; and Consistency-Bi, represented by a red solid line with star markers. The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately 12.5 BLEU at AL 0 and increases to around 26 BLEU at AL 7, with a notable upward trend. The Inconsistency-CE line starts at around 19 BLEU at AL 0 and increases to approximately 27 BLEU at AL 7. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at about 20 BLEU at AL 0 and increases to around 27 BLEU at AL 7. The Consistency-Bi line starts at approximately 23 BLEU at AL 0 and increases to around 28 BLEU at AL 7, maintaining a relatively steady upward trend throughout.
